item.title: Tintinnalogia: A 17th-century technique for generative music
item.description: video upload by Electrum Modular "Introducing my second sequencer for the Disting NT: Tintinnalogia. This Lua script (written with Claude) is an implementation of 'change ringing.' Invented in 17C England, change ringing is essentially a procedure for ringing church bells.
